page_title: SUN 2-0 WOL | Sunderland v Wolves 18/10/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

raw: Hjelde L. F. Achilles Tendon Injury

commentary.text: 90+8' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+5' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Daniel Neil (Sunderland) replaces Noah Sadiki.
90+2' 2 - 0 Ladislav Krejci (Wolves) gets on the scoresheet, but unfortunately for him it's an own goal.
90' We will have 6 min. of added time.
90' Marshall Munetsi (Wolves) beats the defender to the ball in the box and shoots, but the ball flashes well past the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Sunderland.

86' The ball falls kindly for Jackson Tchatchoua (Wolves) inside the box and he goes for goal. It's a decent effort but flies just wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Sunderland will have a goal kick.
85' Toluwalase Emmanuel Arokodare (Wolves) finds himself in a promising position to finish! He unleashes a poor shot which flies into the stands. What a poor effort that was!
83' Nordi Mukiele (Sunderland) plays in a hopeful cross, but it doesn't find its way to any of the attacking players.
81' Sunderland keep possession of the ball by producing one-two passes, but an opponent steps in and wins the ball.
77' Substitution. Jhon Arias will be replaced by Jackson Tchatchoua (Wolves).
76' Rodrigo Gomes comes off the pitch to be replaced by Toluwalase Emmanuel Arokodare (Wolves).
76' Wilson Isidor will be replaced by Eliezer Mayenda (Sunderland).
76' Regis Le Bris prepares a substitution. Christopher Rigg is replaced by Lutsharel Geertruida (Sunderland).
76' Vitor Pereira has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Fernando Lopez (Wolves) replacing Joao Gomes.
74' The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Sunderland.
72' Wolves showcase their great team work by exchanging one-two passes, but one wayward pass sees them lose possession.
68' Joao Gomes (Wolves) cracks a shot goalwards from the edge of the box, but his radar is off and it sails well wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Sunderland will have a goal kick.
67' Here is a change. Matt Doherty is going off and Vitor Pereira gives the last tactical orders to Ki-Jana Hoever (Wolves).
67' Wolves seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
66' The ball is out of play. Sunderland will take a throw-in.
63' Bertrand Traore goes off the pitch and Chemsdine Talbi (Sunderland) comes on.
63' Wilson Isidor (Sunderland) makes space inside the box for a shot, but his effort goes just wide of the right post.
62' Sunderland are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
60' A cross is clipped into the penalty area by Hugo Bueno (Wolves) but poses no threat.
60' A cross into the box from Hugo Bueno (Wolves) is cleared.
58' Wolves concede a free kick after one of their players holds onto an opposition player.
55' Hugo Bueno (Wolves) sends a long crossfield pass searching out one of his teammates, but his effort comes to nothing and they lose possession.
51' Rodrigo Gomes (Wolves) squandered a huge opportunity from inside the 6-yard box. He blazed it high over the bar.
50' The Wolves players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
48' Santiago Bueno (Wolves) has a great chance to score from deep inside the box! He finds some space for the shot, but sends it errantly way past the left post. Very poor attempt.

47' A cross by Ladislav Krejci (Wolves) from the side of the pitch flies into the box, but fails to find its intended target as the aim was poor. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Sunderland.
46' Wolves are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
46' The second half has just started.
45+5' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+4' A cross from a corner kick by Wolves is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.
45+4' Noah Sadiki (Sunderland) fires a shot at goal from a very promising position outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
45' 4 additional min. will be played.
42' Noah Sadiki (Sunderland) wins the ball near the penalty spot and unleashes a header towards the middle of the goal, but Sam Johnstone is alert and denies him.
41' Sunderland can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
41' The Sunderland players are displaying brilliant short passes and great ball movement. They are waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.

38' Matt Doherty (Wolves) found some space to play in a lofted pass, but he looks disappointed as none of his teammates managed to connect with it. The ball goes out of play and Sunderland will have a goal kick.
37' Great teamplay by Sunderland as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
36' One of the Sunderland players was holding his opponent and the referee doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle.
34' Andre (Wolves) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
32' The resulting set piece from Wolves is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
30' The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Sunderland.
28' 62:38 – the latest ball possession ratio.

28' Sunderland slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
27' Enzo Le Fee (Sunderland) latches on to a cross to head the ball towards goal, but it crashes against the left post! Unlucky.
24' Trai Hume (Sunderland) unleashes a decent shot towards goal from long range, but his effort just misses the target.
23' Sunderland win a direct free kick in a dangerous mid-range position.
21' A player from Wolves commits a rough challenge. Robert Jones blows for a foul and keeps the game under control.
16' 1 - 0 Nordi Mukiele (Sunderland) collects a delightful pass inside the box and nets with a perfect low drive into the middle of the goal. What a clinical finish!
16' The ball has crossed the sideline. Sunderland are taking a throw-in.
14' Nordi Mukiele (Sunderland) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
11' Sunderland seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
8' Marshall Munetsi (Wolves) attempts to find one of his teammates with a fine lofted pass, but the defence reacts well to intercept the effort.
7' Joao Gomes (Wolves) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
6' Wonderful movement by Sunderland. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
5' A player from Wolves brings down an opponent and commits a foul.

2' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Sunderland are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
1' The match has just started.
Wolves will kick-off.
Robert Jones will officiate today.
